Title: Need a few trivial questions cleared up by someone who has lots of Sabbat War cards.

Messages.Author: Dog
Messages.Body:
I'm almost ready to release the latest version of the Archon's Briefing,
but...

I was checking various sources against each other and have noticed some
uncertainty about some card names.

Such confusion is trivial only until you try writing a database which
interfaces with other VTES utilities.
:o(

If you are lucky enough to posess the following cards, please could you
check a few things for me?

1) Darrel Boyce or Darrell Boyce? (SW)
2) What is the punctuation in Ecoterrorists? (VTES version)
3) Francisco Domingo de Polonia, or Franciso Domingo de Polonia?
(SWLasombra)
4) What is the punctuation in Grave Robbing? (VTES version)
5) Kyle Strathcona or Kyle Strathacona? (SWVentrue)
6) 'Rom Gypsy' or 'Rom Gypsies' (DS)
7) How is Smiling Jack's card punctuated? (VTES version)

In all of these cases I need the correct capitalisation too please :o)

Thanks in advance for your help. :o)
-----
On the net nobody can tell you're a dog.
Peace & Mung Beans,
Dog
